# The patchelf that maturin runs inside each Linux build image in
# publish-pypi.yml, when it copies a library into a wheel and points the
# extension's needed entry and run path at the copy. The linux and musllinux
# jobs install it with maturin and mount it read only into the image. It is
# pinned by hash and installed with --require-hashes, wheels only and no
# dependency resolution. Generated with `uv pip compile --python-version
# 3.10.22 --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --only-binary :all:
# --generate-hashes`.
